tour.step.dashboard_search.title: Find repositories quickly
tour.step.dashboard_search.description: Use this search box to find a project by name or path instead of scanning the whole list manually.
tour.step.dashboard_create.title: Create a new repository
tour.step.dashboard_create.description: This button opens the setup flow that connects a folder, chooses formats and enables version tracking.
tour.step.explorer_tree.title: Folder tree
tour.step.explorer_tree.description: The folder tree on the left works like a familiar file manager. Pick a branch to browse its contents.
tour.step.explorer_files.title: Current folder files
tour.step.explorer_files.description: The center area lists files in the current folder. Double-click a file to open it or a folder to go deeper.
tour.step.explorer_details.title: History and selected file
tour.step.explorer_details.description: The right panel shows pending changes, gives access to snapshot history and helps you work with the currently selected file.
tour.step.explorer_restore.title: Restore file versions
tour.step.explorer_restore.description: When a file already has saved versions, you can restore it as a copy or replace the current file with the selected version here.
tour.step.explorer_history.title: Snapshot history
tour.step.explorer_history.description: Snapshot history lets you open previous repository states, inspect changes, and restore the file version you need.
tour.step.snapshot_history_panel.title: Snapshot history
tour.step.snapshot_history_panel.descrip: This area shows saved repository snapshots. Pick one to inspect changed files and available versions.
tour.step.explorer_settings.title: Repository settings
tour.step.explorer_settings.description: This button opens the current repository settings: tracked formats, cloud copy, cleanup rules, and data transfer tools.
tour.step.repository_info.title: Repository details
tour.step.repository_info.description: This section lets you update the repository name, description, and the folder path that stays under version tracking.
tour.step.repository_formats.title: Tracked formats
tour.step.repository_formats.description: Use this block to choose which file types should be preserved in history and which ones can be ignored.
tour.step.repository_sync.title: Cloud copy
tour.step.repository_sync.description: Here you can see the cloud copy status, send new versions, and repair the cloud copy if it falls behind.
tour.step.repository_retention.title: Automatic cleanup
tour.step.repository_retention.descripti: This section controls automatic cleanup of old or excessive versions when you want to keep storage growth under control.
tour.step.open_settings.title: Global settings
tour.step.open_settings.description: Open settings to switch language, theme, interface mode and manage cloud sync behavior.
tour.step.settings_mode.title: Basic and professional modes
tour.step.settings_mode.description: Keep basic mode for the simplest interface. Professional mode shows more technical details and diagnostics.
tour.step.settings_guided_tour.title: Replay the guided tour
tour.step.settings_guided_tour.descripti: If you want another quick walkthrough later, you can launch the guided tour again straight from settings.
tour.step.settings_user.title: Users and sign-in
tour.step.settings_user.description: This section manages known profiles, cloud sign-in, and the currently active application account.
tour.step.settings_sync.title: Cloud synchronization
tour.step.settings_sync.description: This section lets you restore data from the cloud, send the latest versions, and continue synchronization after an interruption.
tour.step.settings_journal.title: Operation journal
tour.step.settings_journal.description: The journal keeps recent application actions such as snapshots, synchronization, restore operations, and other important events.
